blocks.text: Choosing cooking oil can feel confusing. Online debates are endless, and with so many different claims, it can be hard to know what really matters. So, what should Filipinos look for when choosing an everyday cooking oil? Cardiologist Dr. Emilita S. Lapuz, FPCP, FPCC, FPSVM says many of her patients ask the same thing: “More Filipinos want healthier lives, but nutritious choices can seem costly. Many patients rely on fried food and ask, ‘Doc, what oil should I use?’” For Dr. Lapuz, the key is to check the fats inside. Oils high in saturated and trans fats are less ideal, while […]...
